expert_term.local: perito (perito oficial; perito do juízo); assistente técnico
expert_term.en: expert: official forensic expert (criminal) or court-appointed expert (civil); party-appointed technical assistant (assistente técnico)

appointment.basis: Código de Processo Penal (Decreto-Lei 3.689/1941) arts. 158, 159, 178, 276, 277; Lei 12.030/2009 arts. 1, 2, 5
appointment.summary_en: Where an offence leaves traces, an examination of the corpus delicti is mandatory and cannot be replaced by confession (art. 158). Examinations are performed by an official expert holding a higher-education degree; in the absence of one, by two suitable persons with a higher-education degree, preferably in the specific area, who must take an undertaking to perform the task well and faithfully (art. 159 caput, §§ 1-2). The examination is requisitioned by the authority from the director of the forensic service (art. 178). The parties do not intervene in the appointment of the expert (art. 276); an expert appointed by the authority must accept unless excused (art. 277). Official criminal experts (criminal experts, forensic physicians and forensic odontologists) are recruited by public competition and have technical, scientific and functional autonomy (Lei 12.030/2009 arts. 2, 5).

questions.summary_en: The authority and the parties may formulate questions (quesitos) until the examination takes place (art. 176); the Ministério Público, assistant prosecutor, victim, private prosecutor and accused may formulate questions and appoint a technical assistant (art. 159 § 3). During the trial the parties may request that the experts be heard to clarify the evidence or answer questions, with at least 10 days' notice, and answers may be given in a supplementary report (art. 159 § 5, I). The experts describe in detail what they examine and answer the questions formulated (art. 160). Except for the corpus delicti examination, the judge or police authority refuses an examination not necessary to establish the truth (art. 184). The CPP does not expressly regulate refusal of questions outside the expertise.

items_en: Detailed description of each trace as found at the scene or on the body (fixation), mandatory in the report of the expert who attended
Processing (the examination itself) using a methodology appropriate to the trace, formalised in a report by an expert
Link between stored material and the report number
Report delivered within 10 days, extendable in exceptional cases at the experts' request
Report signed and initialled on each page by all experts; if experts disagree, each one's statements and answers are recorded or each writes a separate report
items_local: "Os peritos elaborarão o laudo pericial, onde descreverão minuciosamente o que examinarem, e responderão aos quesitos formulados." (art. 160)

"fixação: descrição detalhada do vestígio conforme se encontra no local de crime ou no corpo de delito, e a sua posição na área de exames, podendo ser ilustrada por fotografias, filmagens ou croqui, sendo indispensável a sua descrição no laudo pericial produzido pelo perito responsável pelo atendimento" (art. 158-B, III)

"processamento: exame pericial em si, manipulação do vestígio de acordo com a metodologia adequada às suas características biológicas, físicas e químicas, a fim de se obter o resultado desejado, que deverá ser formalizado em laudo produzido por perito" (art. 158-B, VIII)

"armazenamento: procedimento referente à guarda, em condições adequadas, do material a ser processado, guardado para realização de contraperícia, descartado ou transportado, com vinculação ao número do laudo correspondente" (art. 158-B, IX)
"O laudo pericial será elaborado no prazo máximo de 10 dias, podendo este prazo ser prorrogado, em casos excepcionais, a requerimento dos peritos." (art. 160, parágrafo único)

"o laudo, que poderá ser datilografado, será subscrito e rubricado em suas folhas por todos os peritos" (art. 179, parágrafo único); "Se houver divergência entre os peritos, serão consignadas no auto do exame as declarações e respostas de um e de outro, ou cada um redigirá separadamente o seu laudo" (art. 180)

rights_duties.summary_en: Chain of custody: all procedures to maintain and document the chronological history of a trace from recognition to disposal (art. 158-A); ten stages from recognition to disposal (art. 158-B); collection preferably by an official expert (art. 158-C); sealed containers with individually numbered seals, opened only by the examining expert, with every seal break recorded (art. 158-D); custody centres with logged access (art. 158-E); return of material to the custody centre after examination (art. 158-F). Technical assistants act after admission by the judge and after the official report; material underlying the examination is made available to them at the official body (art. 159 §§ 4, 6). The authority orders correction or clarification of reports with omissions, obscurities or contradictions (art. 181). The judge is not bound by the report (art. 182). Experts are subject to judicial discipline (art. 275), must accept appointment save for a legitimate excuse and are fined for failing to appear or deliver (art. 277), and may not act if they testified or previously opined on the object (art. 279).

appointment.summary_en: The judge is assisted by an expert when proof of a fact depends on technical or scientific knowledge; experts are appointed from legally qualified professionals and technical or scientific bodies registered in a roster kept by the court (art. 156 §§ 1-3), or freely where no one is registered (§ 5). The judge appoints an expert specialised in the subject and sets the deadline for the report (art. 465). The parties may jointly choose the expert if they are fully capable and the case allows settlement (art. 471). Examinations of authenticity or falsity of documents are preferably entrusted to official specialised bodies (art. 478).

questions.summary_en: Within 15 days of the appointment the parties may challenge the expert, appoint technical assistants and submit questions (art. 465 § 1); supplementary questions may be submitted during the examination (art. 469). The judge rejects irrelevant questions and formulates his own (art. 470). The expert must answer all questions conclusively (art. 473, IV) and is forbidden to exceed the limits of the appointment or to issue personal opinions beyond the technical or scientific examination of its object (art. 473 § 2). The expert must clarify, within 15 days, points of divergence or doubt raised by the parties, the judge or the Ministério Público, or by a technical assistant's opinion (art. 477 § 2).

report_contents.basis: CPC art. 473 (and art. 465 § 2 for the expert's initial filing)
items_en: Statement of the object of the examination
The technical or scientific analysis carried out
The method used, explained and shown to be predominantly accepted by specialists in the field
Conclusive answers to all questions submitted by the judge, the parties and the Ministério Público
Reasoning in plain language with logical coherence, indicating how the conclusions were reached
No opinions beyond the limits of the appointment or beyond the technical or scientific examination
Supporting spreadsheets, maps, plans, drawings, photographs or other elements as needed
On appointment: fee proposal, curriculum with proof of specialisation, professional contacts including e-mail (within 5 days)
items_local: I - a exposição do objeto da perícia;
II - a análise técnica ou científica realizada pelo perito;
III - a indicação do método utilizado, esclarecendo-o e demonstrando ser predominantemente aceito pelos especialistas da área do conhecimento da qual se originou;
IV - resposta conclusiva a todos os quesitos apresentados pelo juiz, pelas partes e pelo órgão do Ministério Público.
§ 1º No laudo, o perito deve apresentar sua fundamentação em linguagem simples e com coerência lógica, indicando como alcançou suas conclusões.
§ 2º É vedado ao perito ultrapassar os limites de sua designação, bem como emitir opiniões pessoais que excedam o exame técnico ou científico do objeto da perícia.
§ 3º ... instruir o laudo com planilhas, mapas, plantas, desenhos, fotografias ou outros elementos necessários ao esclarecimento do objeto da perícia.

Art. 465 § 2º: I - proposta de honorários; II - currículo, com comprovação de especialização; III - contatos profissionais, em especial o endereço eletrônico, para onde serão dirigidas as intimações pessoais.

rights_duties.summary_en: The expert must perform the task within the set time with all diligence and may decline for a legitimate reason within 15 days (art. 157). Grounds of impediment and suspicion apply to experts as auxiliaries of justice (arts. 148-149, 467). The expert performs the task scrupulously without the need for a formal undertaking (art. 466) and must give the parties' technical assistants access to the examinations with at least 5 days' documented notice (art. 466 § 2). The expert may be replaced for lack of technical knowledge or failure to meet the deadline, with notice to the professional body and a possible fine (art. 468). One extension of half the deadline is possible (art. 476). The report is filed at least 20 days before the hearing (art. 477). The judge assesses the report freely, stating reasons and taking account of the method used (art. 479).

statute.title_local: Lei nº 12.030, de 17 de setembro de 2009 — Dispõe sobre as perícias oficiais e dá outras providências (normas gerais para as perícias oficiais de natureza criminal)
statute.title_en: Law 12,030 of 17 September 2009 on official forensic examinations (general rules for official criminal forensic examinations)

liability.norm: Código Penal (Decreto-Lei 2.848/1940) art. 342 (falso testemunho ou falsa perícia)
liability.summary_en: Making a false statement, or denying or concealing the truth, as a witness, expert, accountant, translator or interpreter in judicial or administrative proceedings, police inquiry or arbitration: imprisonment (reclusão) of 2 to 4 years and a fine; increased by one sixth to one third if committed through bribery or to obtain evidence for criminal proceedings or civil proceedings involving a public-administration entity (§ 1); not punishable if, before judgment in the proceedings, the offender retracts or tells the truth (§ 2). Bribing an expert is punished under art. 343 (3 to 4 years and a fine).
liability.warning_local: Comprometo-me a bem e fielmente desempenhar o encargo, ciente de que fazer afirmação falsa, ou negar ou calar a verdade como perito em processo judicial constitui crime previsto no art. 342 do Código Penal.
liability.warning_en: I undertake to perform the task well and faithfully, aware that making a false statement, or denying or concealing the truth as an expert in judicial proceedings is a crime under article 342 of the Criminal Code.

liability.summary_en: An expert who, wilfully or negligently, provides untrue information is liable for the damage caused to the party and is barred from acting in other examinations for 2 to 5 years, regardless of other legal sanctions; the judge must notify the expert's professional body.
liability.warning_local: O perito que, por dolo ou culpa, prestar informações inverídicas responderá pelos prejuízos que causar à parte e ficará inabilitado para atuar em outras perícias no prazo de 2 (dois) a 5 (cinco) anos, independentemente das demais sanções previstas em lei, devendo o juiz comunicar o fato ao respectivo órgão de classe para adoção das medidas que entender cabíveis.
liability.warning_en: An expert who, wilfully or negligently, provides untrue information shall be liable for the damage caused to the party and shall be barred from acting in other examinations for 2 (two) to 5 (five) years, regardless of other sanctions provided by law, and the judge shall notify the competent professional body so that it may take the measures it deems appropriate.

declaration.basis: Criminal route: non-official experts 'prestarão o compromisso de bem e fielmente desempenhar o encargo' (CPP art. 159 § 2). Civil route: the court expert performs the task 'independentemente de termo de compromisso' (CPC art. 466), so no statutory declaration is required in the report. The closing text below is composed from the statutory wording.
declaration.text_local: Declaro, sob as penas da lei, que desempenhei bem e fielmente o encargo, que o presente laudo expõe com fidelidade os exames realizados, o método utilizado e as conclusões a que cheguei, e que não ultrapassei os limites da minha designação.
declaration.text_en: I declare, under the penalties of law, that I have performed the task well and faithfully, that this report faithfully sets out the examinations carried out, the method used and the conclusions I reached, and that I have not exceeded the limits of my appointment.

standards.title_en: Guidelines for identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of digital evidence; Brazilian adoption reported as ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 27037:2013 (not verified on the ABNT catalogue)

esignature.law_local: Medida Provisória nº 2.200-2/2001 (ICP-Brasil), art. 10; Lei nº 14.063/2020, art. 4º; Lei nº 11.419/2006 (processo judicial eletrônico), art. 1º § 2º, III
esignature.law_en: ICP-Brasil is established to guarantee the authenticity, integrity and legal validity of electronic documents (MP 2.200-2 art. 1). Statements in electronic documents produced with an ICP-Brasil certification process are presumed true in relation to the signatories; other means of proving authorship and integrity, including non-ICP-Brasil certificates, are valid if accepted by the parties or by the person against whom the document is used (art. 10 §§ 1-2). Law 14.063/2020 classifies electronic signatures as simple, advanced and qualified (ICP-Brasil certificate), the qualified one having the highest level of reliability (art. 4); its Chapter II (interactions with public bodies) does not apply to judicial proceedings (art. 2, sole paragraph, I). In electronic court proceedings an electronic signature is either a digital signature based on a certificate issued by an accredited certification authority or registration with the Judiciary (Lei 11.419/2006 art. 1 § 2, III); electronically produced documents filed with guaranteed origin and signatory are considered originals (art. 11).

timestamp.qualified_recognition: No provision on electronic timestamps was found in MP 2.200-2/2001 or Lei 14.063/2020. ICP-Brasil timestamping (carimbo do tempo) is regulated by ICP-Brasil technical documents, which were not verified.

open_questions: planalto.gov.br returned 'Acesso Negado' to this network; all statutory texts were taken from the Chamber of Deputies 'norma atualizada' consolidations (www2.camara.leg.br/legin), which carry the notice that they do not replace the DOU original and show no consolidation date. Recheck against Planalto compiled texts.
ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 27037:2013 (Brazilian adoption of ISO/IEC 27037) could not be verified on the ABNT catalogue.
ICP-Brasil rules on timestamping (carimbo do tempo, ITI/ICP-Brasil DOC-ICP documents) and any legal effect of timestamps were not verified.
CNJ Resolution on the court roster of experts (CPTEC, implementing CPC art. 156) could not be fetched (atos.cnj.jus.br returned 403).
No official Brazilian digital-forensics guide (e.g. Ministry of Justice/SENASP chain-of-custody procedures or Polícia Federal guidance) was verified.
No statutory formula for a statement of truth in a forensic report exists in the CPP or CPC; the declaration and warning texts are composed.
